tagline: The card. The number. The miss.
confidence_key: BET = fire a unit. LEAN = half unit or skip if tight. FADE = posted because every game needs a number; would not fire real money.

NFL: Split the side from the scorer. Irving, Bijan, Jeanty, Jefferson, Likely, and Goedert cashed while the other number died or leaked.
Run identity is a real favorite. Bears -3, Ravens -3, Bills -1.5, and Jets +1.5 with Hall all cashed.
Large home chalk leaked. Saints +7.5, Cardinals +9.5, Commanders +5.5. Chargers -9.5 and Titans -1.5 died outright.
Travel-week favorite died. 49ers +3.5 won 27-7 in Melbourne.
A total under 45 is a dog number, not a quarterback stack. Patriots +3 pushed 13-10. Henry the TE did not score. Raridon did.
Ugly home covers still cover. Steelers 20-13 cashed -6.5. Bengals covered -3.5 with Chase quiet.
CFB: Fire 6-to-14 point ranked sides in real Power or conference games. Alabama -10, BYU -7, Missouri -5.5, Texas A&M -14.5, Tennessee -11.5, Utah -7, Ohio State +1.5 all cashed.
A late-lead dog still has a number. Ohio State +1.5 cashed 24-23 after Texas erased 20.
Paycheck 28-plus can cash against FCS. Miami, Louisville, Virginia, Georgia, Notre Dame, SMU, Houston covered. Stamp stays FADE. We do not fire it.
LSU -10.5 in Week 1 was a real game (51-10 Clemson). That is not the same ticket as LSU -35.5 in Week 2.
MLB: A plus-money dog still needs the starter to keep it close after three innings.
Confirm the lineup at first pitch. A bat that does not play is a void.
Soto HR and Cole o2.5 ER cashed while Yankees ML died 12-2. Split the bat from the chalk ML.

NFL: Yards are not touchdowns. McCaffrey 68-20-0. Kincaid 130 yards, 0 TD. Hunter Henry missed. Harrison missed on a side that cashed.
A fat road dog is not automatic. Browns +8.5 lost by 24. Falcons +6.5 lost 20-13.
Do not copy Wednesday's 13-10 onto Sunday. Bears-Panthers put up 96. Carolina scored 37 and still lost by 22.
Do not lay brand home or road juice. Cowboys -2.5 lost outright. Packers +1.5 died after Love threw for 387. Flores sent extra.
Do not buy Miami points against a featured home back. Never in the number after Q1.
Do not attach WR1 or TE TD to a dog you already like. Separate those tickets.
DEN at KC is still live. Do not write that review until the whistle.
CFB: Do not treat a 50-point FCS win as a repeatable fire. Week 2 landmines: Indiana 55-0 missed -57.5, Ole Miss 41-9 missed -47.5, LSU 45-14 missed -35.5.
Do not lay 20-plus on the road after a one-score opener. Oregon -23.5 died 39-31 at Oklahoma State.
A 50-0 G5 tape is not a road license. Oklahoma -5.5 never led at Michigan.
A 28-point home favorite with pieces out is a pass. Washington 16-14 missed -27.5.
Rivalry dogs keep ranked favorites inside a touchdown. Iowa 16-13 missed -14.
Winning is not covering. Penn State 27-9 missed -24.5. Texas Tech 35-24 missed -25.5. USC 49-30 missed -21.5.
MLB: Do not lay home juice worse than -200.
Do not glue Friday's final onto Saturday's rematch. Yankees cashed Friday and lost 12-2 Saturday.
Orioles ML died Saturday after cashing Friday. A plus-money dog is one game, not a series.
